content.title: Small-Cap Financials Are Powering Ahead. The Charts Point to More.
content.summary: Small-cap financial stocks are in the driver’s seat, poised to benefit as a weakening job market increases the odds that interest rates will be cut soon.  Smaller companies tend to benefit disproportionately from lower rates because the vast majority of them tend to rely on borrowed money to keep their businesses going.  Financial stocks, meanwhile, gain because people borrow more when loans are more affordable.
